I've skipped over testing because there isn't really much to test... Recharts isn't really easy to test either.

Data transformation logic for `<StackedAreaChart />` is required as the data format that rechart uses requires the stacked value to be on the data point key (and not the reverse, as our values are dynamic).

so for example, we would need to transform our data points from this:
```
{timestamp: 1234, status_code: 200, count: 1}
```
to something like this:
```
{timestamp: 1234, 200: 1, 201: 2, ...} 
```

issue_context.title: Add chart and table for some more REST analytics on project overview
issue_context.body: Show API status codes chart on project overview. Should give us something like: Logflare prod endpoint ID: 66 Show API response times, etc table under status codes chart. Should give us something like: Logflare prod endpoint ID: 67 Stories: - [ ] User should be able to click on a row in the table and get taken to the API log search with the appropriate SQL query - [ ] User should be able to click the chart and get taken to the API log search page with the appropriate SQL query - [ ] Hour / day / week picker on the project overview should affect these data as well
